source_text: Penile cancer, nearly exclusive to uncircumcised men due to chronic inflammation and HPV persistence under the foreskin, shows substantially lower incidence in circumcised cohorts; systematic reviews indicate childhood circumcision reduces invasive penile cancer risk by over 3-fold, with protective effects mediated partly by HPV clearance. [29]
